theorems.name: Submission.cmcdt_lpi_pc_scalar_weak_continuity
theorems.statement: ∀ (m p r : ℕ) (L : NNReal) (v : ℕ → Euclid m → Euclid p) (v₀ : Euclid m → Euclid p) (a : Fin r → Fin p) (b : Fin r → Fin m) (w : Euclid m → ℝ) (f : Euclid p → ℝ), (∀ j, LipschitzWith L (v j)) → LipschitzWith L v₀ → TendstoUniformly v v₀ atTop → Integrable w → Continuous f → HasCompactSupport f → Tendsto (fun j => ∫ u, w u * (f (v j u) * Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun s t => fderiv ℝ (v j) u (EuclideanSpace.single (b t) 1) (a s)))) atTop (𝓝 (∫ u, w u * (f (v₀ u) * Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun s t => fderiv ℝ v₀ u (EuclideanSpace.single (b t) 1) (a s)))))
